usage: The word 生物 (sang1 mat6) is a noun that refers to living organisms including animals and plants.
It can be used as the subject or object of a sentence when talking about biology or living beings.
In some cases, 生物 can also describe organisms in different environments, such as marine 生物 or terrestrial 生物.
It often pairs with adjectives to specify types or characteristics, like 微生物 (microorganisms) or 海洋生物 (marine organisms).
